152: 		result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, fmt.Sprintf("%d progress events were dropped", runProcess.DroppedEvents))
153: 	}
154: 	if runProcess.StdoutTruncated {
155: 		return smokeFailedResult(result, smokeError("smoke_run_truncated", "process", "run response exceeded the configured stdout bound", "Increase the bounded capture limit or reduce run output.", nil))
156: 	}
157: 	var response smokeRunResponse
158: 	decodeErr := decodeOneJSON(runProcess.Stdout, &response)
159: 	if decodeErr != nil {
160: 		if runErr != nil {
161: 			return smokeFailedResult(result, classifyProcessSmokeError("run", runProcess, runErr))
162: 		}
163: 		return smokeFailedResult(result, smokeError("smoke_run_malformed", "protocol", "run did not return one valid JSON object", "Inspect external harness evidence and fix its protocol output.", decodeErr))
164: 	}
165: 	if runProcess.TimedOut || runProcess.Cancelled || !runProcess.CleanupComplete {
166: 		return smokeFailedResult(result, classifyProcessSmokeError("run", runProcess, runErr))
167: 	}
168: 	emit(SmokeProgress{Phase: SmokePhaseValidatingEvidence, Message: "validating external evidence identity"})
169: 	validated, issues, tests, err := validateSmokeRun(prepared, discovery, selection, response, runProcess)
170: 	if err != nil {
171: 		return smokeFailedResult(result, err)
172: 	}
173: 	result.RunID, result.Runtime, result.Model = response.RunID, response.Runtime, response.Model
174: 	result.Duration = time.Duration(response.DurationMs) * time.Millisecond
175: 	result.Counts = SmokeCounts{Total: response.Counts.Total, Passed: response.Counts.Passed, Failed: response.Counts.Failed, Skipped: response.Counts.Skipped, Errors: response.Counts.Errors}
176: 	result.Evidence, result.Issues, result.Tests = validated, issues, tests
177: 	result.Verdict = synthesizeSmokeVerdict(result.Counts, issues)
178: 	result.Status = SmokeCompleted
179: 	result.NextAction = nextSmokeAction(result)
180: 	if result.DiagnosticOnly {
181: 		return result, nil
182: 	}
183: 	emit(SmokeProgress{Phase: SmokePhaseWritingArtifact, Message: "writing validated smoke summary"})
184: 	committed, commitErr := s.commitSmoke(prepared, result)
185: 	if commitErr == nil {
186: 		emit(SmokeProgress{Phase: SmokePhaseCompleted, Message: "smoke complete"})
187: 	}
188: 	return committed, commitErr
189: }

191: func (s Service) saveSmokeAttempt(projectRef, sprintRef string, result SmokeResult, runErr error, terminal bool) error {
192: 	sp, _, _, err := s.resolveSprintInputs(projectRef, sprintRef)
193: 	if err != nil {
194: 		return err
195: 	}
196: 	state, err := LoadFlowState(s.root, sp)
197: 	if err != nil {
198: 		if !errors.Is(err, ErrFlowStateMissing) {
199: 			return err
200: 		}
201: 		snap, readErr := s.store.ReadArtifacts(sp)
202: 		if readErr != nil {
203: 			return readErr
204: 		}
205: 		state = NewFlowState(sp, DeriveStages(sp, snap, nil), s.now())
206: 	}
207: 	now := s.now().UTC()
208: 	current := state.Smoke
209: 	if current == nil {
210: 		current = &SmokeStageState{Path: ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageSmoke)}
211: 	}
212: 	if !terminal {
213: 		current.Status = SmokeRunning
214: 		current.ActiveAttempt = &VerificationAttempt{ID: fmt.Sprintf("smoke-%d", now.UnixNano()), Status: AttemptRunning, StartedAt: now, HeartbeatAt: now, OwnerPID: os.Getpid()}
215: 	} else {
216: 		attempt := VerificationAttempt{ID: fmt.Sprintf("smoke-%d", now.UnixNano()), StartedAt: now}
217: 		if current.ActiveAttempt != nil {
218: 			attempt = *current.ActiveAttempt
219: 		}
220: 		attempt.CompletedAt = &now
221: 		attempt.Status = smokeAttemptStatus(result.Status, runErr)
222: 		if se, ok := AsSmokeError(runErr); ok {
223: 			attempt.Category, attempt.Diagnostics, attempt.NextAction = se.Category, []string{safeError(se)}, se.Guidance
224: 		}
225: 		current.ActiveAttempt, current.LastAttempt, current.Status = nil, &attempt, result.Status
226: 		if current.LastComplete != nil && result.Status != SmokeCompleted {
227: 			current.Verdict, current.RunID, current.EvidenceID = current.LastComplete.Verdict, current.LastComplete.RunID, current.LastComplete.EvidenceID
228: 		}
229: 	}
230: 	state.Smoke = current
231: 	return SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, state)
232: }

234: func smokeAttemptStatus(status SmokeExecutionStatus, err error) AttemptStatus {
235: 	if errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) || status == SmokeCancelled {
236: 		return AttemptCancelled
237: 	}
238: 	if se, ok := AsSmokeError(err); ok {
239: 		if se.Category == "timeout" {
240: 			return AttemptTimedOut
241: 		}
242: 		if se.Category == "review_gate" || se.Category == "catalog" {
243: 			return AttemptBlocked
244: 		}
245: 	}
246: 	if status == SmokeCompleted {
247: 		return AttemptCompleted
248: 	}
249: 	return AttemptFailed
250: }

274: func (s Service) ValidateSmoke(projectRef, sprintRef string) (ValidationResult, error) {
275: 	sp, _, _, err := s.resolveSprintInputs(projectRef, sprintRef)
276: 	if err != nil {
277: 		return ValidationResult{}, err
278: 	}
279: 	path, err := ArtifactPath(s.root, sp, StageSmoke)
280: 	if err != nil {
281: 		return ValidationResult{}, err
282: 	}
283: 	data, readErr := os.ReadFile(path)
284: 	var findings []ValidationFinding
285: 	if readErr != nil {
286: 		findings = append(findings, finding("smoke.md", "", ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageSmoke), "missing smoke summary", safeError(readErr), "Run sprint smoke after a current review."))
287: 	} else {
288: 		findings = append(findings, ValidateSmokeContent(string(data))...)
289: 	}
290: 	state, stateErr := LoadFlowState(s.root, sp)
291: 	if stateErr != nil {
292: 		findings = append(findings, finding("Smoke state", "", FlowStateRelPath(sp), "flow state unavailable", safeError(stateErr), "Restore valid flow state."))
293: 	} else if state.Smoke == nil {
294: 		findings = append(findings, finding("Smoke state", "", FlowStateRelPath(sp), "smoke state missing", "smoke.md and flow state are not reconciled", "Rerun smoke after reviewing the committed summary."))
295: 	} else if data != nil {
296: 		fingerprint := hashBytes(data)
297: 		if state.Smoke.SmokeFingerprint != fingerprint {
298: 			findings = append(findings, finding("Smoke state", "", FlowStateRelPath(sp), "artifact/state mismatch", "smoke fingerprint differs from flow state", "Reconcile by rerunning smoke; automated recovery is deferred."))
299: 		}
300: 	}
301: 	return ValidationResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, Artifact: ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageSmoke), Findings: findings}, nil
302: }

304: func validateSmokeRun(p smokePrepared, discovery smokeDiscovery, selection smokeSelection, response smokeRunResponse, proc pprocess.Result) ([]SmokeEvidence, []SmokeIssue, []SmokeTestResult, error) {
305: 	if response.SchemaVersion != 1 || response.ProtocolVersion != p.Manifest.ProtocolVersion || response.HarnessID != p.Manifest.Harness.ID || response.RunID == "" {
306: 		return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_identity", "evidence", "run identity does not match manifest/discovery", "Inspect the external run response.", nil)
307: 	}
308: 	if response.ScopeKind != selection.Kind || strings.Join(response.Scope, ",") != strings.Join(selection.IDs, ",") {
309: 		return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_scope", "evidence", "reported scope does not match the request", "Fix the harness scope identity.", nil)
310: 	}
311: 	c := response.Counts
312: 	if c.Total < 0 || c.Passed < 0 || c.Failed < 0 || c.Skipped < 0 || c.Errors < 0 || c.Passed+c.Failed+c.Skipped+c.Errors != c.Total {
313: 		return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_counts", "evidence", "result counts are inconsistent", "Fix the harness count summary.", nil)
314: 	}
315: 	if response.DurationMs < 0 || len(response.Evidence) == 0 {
316: 		return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_missing", "evidence", "duration or evidence identity is missing", "Emit complete protocol-v1 evidence.", nil)
317: 	}
318: 	expected := expectedSmokeTests(discovery, selection)
319: 	actual := make([]string, 0, len(response.Tests))
320: 	statusCounts := SmokeCountsWire{}
321: 	for _, test := range response.Tests {
322: 		if test.ID == "" {
323: 			return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_tests", "evidence", "run contains an empty test identity", "Return every executed discovered test identity.", nil)
324: 		}
325: 		actual = append(actual, test.ID)
326: 		switch test.Status {
327: 		case "passed":
328: 			statusCounts.Passed++
329: 		case "failed":
330: 			statusCounts.Failed++
331: 		case "skipped":
332: 			statusCounts.Skipped++
333: 		case "error":
334: 			statusCounts.Errors++
335: 		default:
336: 			return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_tests", "evidence", "run contains an unsupported test status", "Use passed, failed, skipped, or error.", nil)
337: 		}
338: 	}
339: 	statusCounts.Total = len(response.Tests)
340: 	sort.Strings(expected)
341: 	sort.Strings(actual)
342: 	if strings.Join(expected, "\x00") != strings.Join(actual, "\x00") || statusCounts != c {
343: 		return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_tests", "evidence", "executed test identities/statuses do not match discovery and counts", "Run exactly the selected discovered tests and return their identities.", nil)
344: 	}
345: 	var evidence []SmokeEvidence
346: 	for _, item := range response.Evidence {
347: 		root := p.RunsRoot
348: 		if item.Kind == "issue" {
349: 			root = p.IssuesRoot
350: 		}
351: 		full := item.Path
352: 		if !filepath.IsAbs(full) {
353: 			full = filepath.Join(p.HarnessRoot, filepath.FromSlash(full))
354: 		}
355: 		resolved, err := canonicalFileInside(root, full)
356: 		if err != nil {
357: 			return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_path", "evidence", "evidence path escapes or is missing", "Keep evidence inside declared roots.", err)
358: 		}
359: 		info, err := os.Stat(resolved)
360: 		if err != nil {
361: 			return nil, nil, nil, err
362: 		}
363: 		hash, err := hashFile(resolved)
364: 		if err != nil {
365: 			return nil, nil, nil, err
366: 		}
367: 		if item.SHA256 != "" && !strings.EqualFold(item.SHA256, hash) {
368: 			return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_hash", "evidence", "evidence hash mismatch", "Restore immutable run evidence or rerun smoke.", nil)
369: 		}
370: 		if !strings.Contains(filepath.Base(resolved), response.RunID) && item.Kind != "issue" {
371: 			return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_run", "evidence", "evidence path does not identify the reported run", "Use run-ID-addressed evidence.", nil)
372: 		}
373: 		evidence = append(evidence, SmokeEvidence{Kind: item.Kind, Path: resolved, SHA256: hash, Size: info.Size(), ModifiedAt: info.ModTime().UTC()})
374: 	}
375: 	issues := append([]SmokeIssue(nil), response.Issues...)
376: 	failedTests := make(map[string]struct{}, c.Failed+c.Errors)
377: 	for _, test := range response.Tests {
378: 		if test.Status == "failed" || test.Status == "error" {
379: 			failedTests[test.ID] = struct{}{}
380: 		}
381: 	}
382: 	filedTests := make(map[string]struct{}, len(issues))
383: 	for i := range issues {
384: 		if issues[i].ID == "" || (issues[i].Status != "open" && issues[i].Status != "resolved") {
385: 			return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_issue_identity", "evidence", "issue identity/status is invalid", "Emit open or resolved issue metadata.", nil)
386: 		}
387: 		full := issues[i].Path
388: 		if !filepath.IsAbs(full) {
389: 			full = filepath.Join(p.HarnessRoot, filepath.FromSlash(full))
390: 		}
391: 		resolved, err := canonicalFileInside(p.IssuesRoot, full)
392: 		if err != nil || !strings.Contains(filepath.Base(resolved), issues[i].ID) {
393: 			return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_issue_path", "evidence", "issue path is missing, escaping, or mismatched", "Use an issue-ID-addressed file under the issues root.", err)
394: 		}
395: 		issues[i].Path = resolved
396: 		if _, failed := failedTests[issues[i].TestID]; failed && issues[i].Status == "open" {
397: 			filedTests[issues[i].TestID] = struct{}{}
398: 		}
399: 		if issues[i].Status == "open" && (issues[i].TestID == "" || issues[i].Severity == "" || issues[i].Title == "" || issues[i].Summary == "" || issues[i].Theory == "" || issues[i].Evidence == "" || issues[i].Action == "") {
400: 			return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_issue_detail", "evidence", "open issue metadata is incomplete", "For every open issue emit test_id, severity, title, summary, theory, evidence, and action.", nil)
401: 		}
402: 	}
403: 	for testID := range failedTests {
404: 		if _, ok := filedTests[testID]; !ok {
405: 			return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_issue_missing", "evidence", "failed test has no detailed open issue: "+testID, "File and return one detailed issue for every failed or errored test.", nil)
406: 		}
407: 	}
408: 	if proc.ExitCode != 0 && c.Failed+c.Errors == 0 {
409: 		return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_process_unexplained", "process", "non-zero process exit has no matching failed evidence", "Inspect external evidence before retrying.", nil)
410: 	}
411: 	return evidence, issues, append([]SmokeTestResult(nil), response.Tests...), nil
412: }

414: func expectedSmokeTests(discovery smokeDiscovery, selection smokeSelection) []string {
415: 	testBySuite := map[string][]string{}
416: 	for _, suite := range discovery.Suites {
417: 		testBySuite[suite.ID] = append([]string(nil), suite.Tests...)
418: 	}
419: 	var out []string
420: 	switch selection.Kind {
421: 	case "test":
422: 		out = append(out, selection.IDs...)
423: 	case "suite":
424: 		for _, suite := range selection.IDs {
425: 			out = append(out, testBySuite[suite]...)
426: 		}
427: 	case "level":
428: 		for _, level := range discovery.Levels {
429: 			if len(selection.IDs) > 0 && level.ID == selection.IDs[0] {
430: 				for _, suite := range level.Suites {
431: 					out = append(out, testBySuite[suite]...)
432: 				}
433: 			}
434: 		}
435: 	}
436: 	return out
437: }

439: func (s Service) commitSmoke(p smokePrepared, result SmokeResult) (SmokeResult, error) {
440: 	content := RenderSmoke(result)
441: 	if findings := ValidateSmokeContent(content); len(findings) > 0 {
442: 		return smokeFailedResult(result, smokeError("smoke_artifact_validation", "validation", findings[0].Problem, findings[0].Suggestion, nil))
443: 	}
444: 	path, err := ArtifactPath(s.root, p.Sprint, StageSmoke)
445: 	if err != nil {
446: 		return smokeFailedResult(result, err)
447: 	}
448: 	if err := atomicWriteFile(path, []byte(content)); err != nil {
449: 		return smokeFailedResult(result, smokeError("smoke_persistence", "persistence", "smoke summary could not be committed", "The previous valid summary was preserved.", err))
450: 	}
451: 	state, err := LoadFlowState(s.root, p.Sprint)
452: 	if err != nil {
453: 		result.Reconciliation = true
454: 		return result, smokeError("smoke_reconciliation", "reconciliation", "smoke.md committed but flow state could not be loaded", "Reconcile flow state by rerunning smoke.", err)
455: 	}
456: 	now := s.now().UTC()
457: 	evidenceID := ""
458: 	if len(result.Evidence) > 0 {
459: 		evidenceID = result.Evidence[0].SHA256
460: 	}
461: 	artifactDigest := hashBytes([]byte(content))
462: 	identityRefs := smokeIdentityReferences(p, result)
463: 	inputFingerprint, _ := refreshEvidenceFingerprint(identityRefs)
464: 	refs := make([]EvidenceReference, 0, len(result.Evidence))
465: 	for _, evidence := range result.Evidence {
466: 		refs = append(refs, EvidenceReference{Kind: evidence.Kind, Path: evidence.Path, Digest: evidence.SHA256})
467: 	}
468: 	var override *DiagnosticOverride
469: 	if result.ReviewOverride {
470: 		override = &DiagnosticOverride{Requested: true, Confirmed: true, Rationale: result.OverrideRationale, RequestedAt: now, ReviewFingerprint: result.ReviewFingerprint, ReviewVerdict: string(result.ReviewVerdict)}
471: 	}
472: 	active := (*VerificationAttempt)(nil)
473: 	if state.Smoke != nil {
474: 		active = state.Smoke.ActiveAttempt
475: 	}
476: 	state.Smoke = &SmokeStageState{Status: result.Status, Verdict: result.Verdict, Path: ArtifactRelPath(p.Sprint, StageSmoke), LastRunAt: &now, ReviewFingerprint: result.ReviewFingerprint, SmokeFingerprint: artifactDigest, ArtifactDigest: artifactDigest, InputFingerprint: inputFingerprint, RunID: result.RunID, AuthorRunID: result.AuthorRunID, AuthorModel: result.AuthorModel, AuthorChangedPaths: append([]string(nil), result.AuthorChangedPaths...), CoverageMapping: result.CoverageMapping, EvidenceID: evidenceID, ReviewOverride: result.ReviewOverride, Diagnostics: result.Diagnostics, Issues: append([]SmokeIssue(nil), result.Issues...), Evidence: refs, Override: override, ActiveAttempt: active, LastComplete: &SmokeCompletion{Verdict: result.Verdict, Artifact: ArtifactRelPath(p.Sprint, StageSmoke), ArtifactDigest: artifactDigest, InputFingerprint: inputFingerprint, CompletedAt: now, RunID: result.RunID, AuthorRunID: result.AuthorRunID, AuthorModel: result.AuthorModel, AuthorChangedPaths: append([]string(nil), result.AuthorChangedPaths...), CoverageMapping: result.CoverageMapping, EvidenceID: evidenceID, Evidence: identityRefs, Issues: append([]SmokeIssue(nil), result.Issues...), Override: override}}
477: 	if err := SaveFlowState(s.root, p.Sprint, state); err != nil {
478: 		result.Reconciliation = true
479: 		return result, smokeError("smoke_reconciliation", "reconciliation", "smoke.md committed but flow state update failed", "Reconcile flow state by rerunning smoke.", err)
480: 	}
481: 	return result, nil
482: }

484: func RenderSmoke(r SmokeResult) string {
485: 	var b strings.Builder
486: 	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "# Sprint Smoke\n\nSmoke status: `%s`\nVerdict: `%s`\nDate: `%s`\n\n", r.Status, r.Verdict, time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339))
487: 	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "## Smoke Context\n\nProject: `%s`\nSprint: `%s`\nArtifact: `%s`\n\n", r.Project, r.Sprint, r.Artifact)
488: 	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "## Review Gate\n\nReview verdict: `%s`\nReview fingerprint: `%s`\nDiagnostic override: `%t`\nOverride rationale: %s\n\n", r.ReviewVerdict, r.ReviewFingerprint, r.ReviewOverride, printable(r.OverrideRationale))
489: 	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "## Harness And Protocol\n\nHarness: `%s`\nProtocol: `%s`\n\n", r.Harness, r.Protocol)
490: 	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "## Smoke Authoring\n\nAuthor run ID: `%s`\nAuthor model: `%s`\nChanged harness paths:\n", printable(r.AuthorRunID), printable(r.AuthorModel))
491: 	if len(r.AuthorChangedPaths) == 0 {
492: 		b.WriteString("- none; existing traceable suite retained after agent inspection\n")
493: 	} else {
494: 		for _, path := range r.AuthorChangedPaths {
495: 			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- `%s`\n", path)
496: 		}
497: 	}
498: 	b.WriteString("\n")
499: 	if mapping := r.CoverageMapping; mapping != nil {
500: 		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "## Coverage Mapping\n\nComplete: `%t`\nRequired coverage: `%s`\nRationale: %s\n\n", mapping.Complete, strings.Join(mapping.RequiredCoverage, "`, `"), printable(mapping.Rationale))
501: 		for _, requirement := range mapping.Requirements {
502: 			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- `%s` — %s (mapped tests: %s)\n", requirement.ID, printable(requirement.Description), printable(strings.Join(requirement.MappedTests, ", ")))
503: 		}
504: 		b.WriteString("\nTests:\n")
505: 		for _, test := range mapping.Tests {
506: 			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- `%s` (suite `%s`): `%s`\n", test.ID, test.Suite, strings.Join(test.Coverage, "`, `"))
507: 		}
508: 		b.WriteString("\n")
509: 	}
510: 	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "## Selected Scope And Rationale\n\nScope kind: `%s`\nScope: `%s`\nRationale: %s\nDuration class: `%s`\nCost class: `%s`\nDiagnostic only: `%t`\n\n", printable(r.ScopeKind), printable(r.Scope), printable(r.ScopeRationale), printable(r.DurationClass), printable(r.CostClass), r.DiagnosticOnly)
511: 	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "## Preconditions And Environment\n\nPrerequisites: %s\nEnvironment: bounded allowlist; values not persisted\nEvidence roots: `%s`\nEffective timeout: `%s` (source `%s`)\n\n", printable(strings.Join(r.Prerequisites, "; ")), printable(strings.Join(r.EvidenceRoots, ", ")), r.EffectiveTimeout, printable(r.TimeoutSource))
512: 	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "## Safe Invocation\n\nArgv: `%s`\n\n", printable(r.SafeArgv))
513: 	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "## Run Evidence\n\nRun ID: `%s`\nTotal: `%d`\nPassed: `%d`\nFailed: `%d`\nSkipped: `%d`\nErrors: `%d`\nDuration: `%s`\nRuntime: `%s`\nModel: `%s`\n\n", printable(r.RunID), r.Counts.Total, r.Counts.Passed, r.Counts.Failed, r.Counts.Skipped, r.Counts.Errors, r.Duration, printable(r.Runtime), printable(r.Model))
514: 	if len(r.Tests) > 0 {
515: 		b.WriteString("Executed tests:\n")
516: 		for _, test := range r.Tests {
517: 			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- `%s`: `%s`\n", test.ID, test.Status)
518: 		}
519: 		b.WriteString("\n")
520: 	}
521: 	b.WriteString("### External Evidence Identity And Links\n\n")
522: 	if len(r.Evidence) == 0 {
523: 		b.WriteString("- none (preflight classification)\n")

224: 		}
225: 		current.ActiveAttempt, current.LastAttempt, current.Status = nil, &attempt, result.Status
226: 		if current.LastComplete != nil && result.Status != SmokeCompleted {
227: 			current.Verdict, current.RunID, current.EvidenceID = current.LastComplete.Verdict, current.LastComplete.RunID, current.LastComplete.EvidenceID
228: 		}
229: 	}
230: 	state.Smoke = current
231: 	return SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, state)
232: }

234: func smokeAttemptStatus(status SmokeExecutionStatus, err error) AttemptStatus {
235: 	if errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) || status == SmokeCancelled {
236: 		return AttemptCancelled
237: 	}
238: 	if se, ok := AsSmokeError(err); ok {
239: 		if se.Category == "timeout" {
240: 			return AttemptTimedOut
241: 		}
242: 		if se.Category == "review_gate" || se.Category == "catalog" {
243: 			return AttemptBlocked
244: 		}
245: 	}
246: 	if status == SmokeCompleted {
247: 		return AttemptCompleted
248: 	}
249: 	return AttemptFailed
250: }

292: 		findings = append(findings, finding("Smoke state", "", FlowStateRelPath(sp), "flow state unavailable", safeError(stateErr), "Restore valid flow state."))
293: 	} else if state.Smoke == nil {

295: 	} else if data != nil {

297: 		if state.Smoke.SmokeFingerprint != fingerprint {
298: 			findings = append(findings, finding("Smoke state", "", FlowStateRelPath(sp), "artifact/state mismatch", "smoke fingerprint differs from flow state", "Reconcile by rerunning smoke; automated recovery is deferred."))
299: 		}
300: 	}
301: 	return ValidationResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, Artifact: ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageSmoke), Findings: findings}, nil
302: }

304: func validateSmokeRun(p smokePrepared, discovery smokeDiscovery, selection smokeSelection, response smokeRunResponse, proc pprocess.Result) ([]SmokeEvidence, []SmokeIssue, []SmokeTestResult, error) {
305: 	if response.SchemaVersion != 1 || response.ProtocolVersion != p.Manifest.ProtocolVersion || response.HarnessID != p.Manifest.Harness.ID || response.RunID == "" {
306: 		return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_identity", "evidence", "run identity does not match manifest/discovery", "Inspect the external run response.", nil)
307: 	}
308: 	if response.ScopeKind != selection.Kind || strings.Join(response.Scope, ",") != strings.Join(selection.IDs, ",") {
309: 		return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_scope", "evidence", "reported scope does not match the request", "Fix the harness scope identity.", nil)
310: 	}
311: 	c := response.Counts
312: 	if c.Total < 0 || c.Passed < 0 || c.Failed < 0 || c.Skipped < 0 || c.Errors < 0 || c.Passed+c.Failed+c.Skipped+c.Errors != c.Total {
313: 		return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_counts", "evidence", "result counts are inconsistent", "Fix the harness count summary.", nil)
314: 	}
315: 	if response.DurationMs < 0 || len(response.Evidence) == 0 {
316: 		return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_missing", "evidence", "duration or evidence identity is missing", "Emit complete protocol-v1 evidence.", nil)
317: 	}
318: 	expected := expectedSmokeTests(discovery, selection)
319: 	actual := make([]string, 0, len(response.Tests))
320: 	statusCounts := SmokeCountsWire{}
321: 	for _, test := range response.Tests {
322: 		if test.ID == "" {
323: 			return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_tests", "evidence", "run contains an empty test identity", "Return every executed discovered test identity.", nil)
324: 		}
325: 		actual = append(actual, test.ID)
326: 		switch test.Status {
327: 		case "passed":
328: 			statusCounts.Passed++
329: 		case "failed":
330: 			statusCounts.Failed++
331: 		case "skipped":
332: 			statusCounts.Skipped++
333: 		case "error":
334: 			statusCounts.Errors++
335: 		default:
336: 			return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_tests", "evidence", "run contains an unsupported test status", "Use passed, failed, skipped, or error.", nil)
337: 		}
338: 	}
339: 	statusCounts.Total = len(response.Tests)
340: 	sort.Strings(expected)
341: 	sort.Strings(actual)
342: 	if strings.Join(expected, "\x00") != strings.Join(actual, "\x00") || statusCounts != c {
343: 		return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_tests", "evidence", "executed test identities/statuses do not match discovery and counts", "Run exactly the selected discovered tests and return their identities.", nil)
344: 	}
345: 	var evidence []SmokeEvidence
346: 	for _, item := range response.Evidence {
347: 		root := p.RunsRoot
348: 		if item.Kind == "issue" {
349: 			root = p.IssuesRoot
350: 		}
351: 		full := item.Path
352: 		if !filepath.IsAbs(full) {
353: 			full = filepath.Join(p.HarnessRoot, filepath.FromSlash(full))
354: 		}
355: 		resolved, err := canonicalFileInside(root, full)
356: 		if err != nil {
357: 			return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_path", "evidence", "evidence path escapes or is missing", "Keep evidence inside declared roots.", err)
358: 		}
359: 		info, err := os.Stat(resolved)
360: 		if err != nil {
361: 			return nil, nil, nil, err
362: 		}
363: 		hash, err := hashFile(resolved)
364: 		if err != nil {
365: 			return nil, nil, nil, err
366: 		}
367: 		if item.SHA256 != "" && !strings.EqualFold(item.SHA256, hash) {
368: 			return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_hash", "evidence", "evidence hash mismatch", "Restore immutable run evidence or rerun smoke.", nil)
369: 		}
370: 		if !strings.Contains(filepath.Base(resolved), response.RunID) && item.Kind != "issue" {
371: 			return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_run", "evidence", "evidence path does not identify the reported run", "Use run-ID-addressed evidence.", nil)
372: 		}
373: 		evidence = append(evidence, SmokeEvidence{Kind: item.Kind, Path: resolved, SHA256: hash, Size: info.Size(), ModifiedAt: info.ModTime().UTC()})
374: 	}
375: 	issues := append([]SmokeIssue(nil), response.Issues...)
376: 	failedTests := make(map[string]struct{}, c.Failed+c.Errors)
377: 	for _, test := range response.Tests {
378: 		if test.Status == "failed" || test.Status == "error" {
379: 			failedTests[test.ID] = struct{}{}
380: 		}
381: 	}
382: 	filedTests := make(map[string]struct{}, len(issues))
383: 	for i := range issues {
384: 		if issues[i].ID == "" || (issues[i].Status != "open" && issues[i].Status != "resolved") {
385: 			return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_issue_identity", "evidence", "issue identity/status is invalid", "Emit open or resolved issue metadata.", nil)
386: 		}
387: 		full := issues[i].Path
388: 		if !filepath.IsAbs(full) {
389: 			full = filepath.Join(p.HarnessRoot, filepath.FromSlash(full))
390: 		}
391: 		resolved, err := canonicalFileInside(p.IssuesRoot, full)
392: 		if err != nil || !strings.Contains(filepath.Base(resolved), issues[i].ID) {
393: 			return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_issue_path", "evidence", "issue path is missing, escaping, or mismatched", "Use an issue-ID-addressed file under the issues root.", err)
394: 		}
395: 		issues[i].Path = resolved
396: 		if _, failed := failedTests[issues[i].TestID]; failed && issues[i].Status == "open" {
397: 			filedTests[issues[i].TestID] = struct{}{}
398: 		}
399: 		if issues[i].Status == "open" && (issues[i].TestID == "" || issues[i].Severity == "" || issues[i].Title == "" || issues[i].Summary == "" || issues[i].Theory == "" || issues[i].Evidence == "" || issues[i].Action == "") {
400: 			return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_issue_detail", "evidence", "open issue metadata is incomplete", "For every open issue emit test_id, severity, title, summary, theory, evidence, and action.", nil)
401: 		}
402: 	}
403: 	for testID := range failedTests {
404: 		if _, ok := filedTests[testID]; !ok {
405: 			return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_issue_missing", "evidence", "failed test has no detailed open issue: "+testID, "File and return one detailed issue for every failed or errored test.", nil)
406: 		}
407: 	}
408: 	if proc.ExitCode != 0 && c.Failed+c.Errors == 0 {
409: 		return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_process_unexplained", "process", "non-zero process exit has no matching failed evidence", "Inspect external evidence before retrying.", nil)
410: 	}
411: 	return evidence, issues, append([]SmokeTestResult(nil), response.Tests...), nil
412: }

414: func expectedSmokeTests(discovery smokeDiscovery, selection smokeSelection) []string {
415: 	testBySuite := map[string][]string{}
416: 	for _, suite := range discovery.Suites {
417: 		testBySuite[suite.ID] = append([]string(nil), suite.Tests...)
418: 	}
419: 	var out []string
420: 	switch selection.Kind {
421: 	case "test":
422: 		out = append(out, selection.IDs...)
423: 	case "suite":
424: 		for _, suite := range selection.IDs {
425: 			out = append(out, testBySuite[suite]...)
426: 		}
427: 	case "level":
428: 		for _, level := range discovery.Levels {
429: 			if len(selection.IDs) > 0 && level.ID == selection.IDs[0] {
430: 				for _, suite := range level.Suites {
431: 					out = append(out, testBySuite[suite]...)
432: 				}
433: 			}
434: 		}
435: 	}
436: 	return out
437: }

439: func (s Service) commitSmoke(p smokePrepared, result SmokeResult) (SmokeResult, error) {
440: 	content := RenderSmoke(result)
441: 	if findings := ValidateSmokeContent(content); len(findings) > 0 {
442: 		return smokeFailedResult(result, smokeError("smoke_artifact_validation", "validation", findings[0].Problem, findings[0].Suggestion, nil))
443: 	}
444: 	path, err := ArtifactPath(s.root, p.Sprint, StageSmoke)
445: 	if err != nil {
446: 		return smokeFailedResult(result, err)
447: 	}
448: 	if err := atomicWriteFile(path, []byte(content)); err != nil {
449: 		return smokeFailedResult(result, smokeError("smoke_persistence", "persistence", "smoke summary could not be committed", "The previous valid summary was preserved.", err))
450: 	}
451: 	state, err := LoadFlowState(s.root, p.Sprint)
452: 	if err != nil {
453: 		result.Reconciliation = true
454: 		return result, smokeError("smoke_reconciliation", "reconciliation", "smoke.md committed but flow state could not be loaded", "Reconcile flow state by rerunning smoke.", err)
455: 	}
456: 	now := s.now().UTC()
457: 	evidenceID := ""
458: 	if len(result.Evidence) > 0 {
459: 		evidenceID = result.Evidence[0].SHA256
460: 	}
461: 	artifactDigest := hashBytes([]byte(content))
462: 	identityRefs := smokeIdentityReferences(p, result)
463: 	inputFingerprint, _ := refreshEvidenceFingerprint(identityRefs)
464: 	refs := make([]EvidenceReference, 0, len(result.Evidence))
465: 	for _, evidence := range result.Evidence {
466: 		refs = append(refs, EvidenceReference{Kind: evidence.Kind, Path: evidence.Path, Digest: evidence.SHA256})
467: 	}
468: 	var override *DiagnosticOverride
469: 	if result.ReviewOverride {
470: 		override = &DiagnosticOverride{Requested: true, Confirmed: true, Rationale: result.OverrideRationale, RequestedAt: now, ReviewFingerprint: result.ReviewFingerprint, ReviewVerdict: string(result.ReviewVerdict)}
471: 	}
472: 	active := (*VerificationAttempt)(nil)
473: 	if state.Smoke != nil {
474: 		active = state.Smoke.ActiveAttempt
475: 	}
476: 	state.Smoke = &SmokeStageState{Status: result.Status, Verdict: result.Verdict, Path: ArtifactRelPath(p.Sprint, StageSmoke), LastRunAt: &now, ReviewFingerprint: result.ReviewFingerprint, SmokeFingerprint: artifactDigest, ArtifactDigest: artifactDigest, InputFingerprint: inputFingerprint, RunID: result.RunID, AuthorRunID: result.AuthorRunID, AuthorModel: result.AuthorModel, AuthorChangedPaths: append([]string(nil), result.AuthorChangedPaths...), CoverageMapping: result.CoverageMapping, EvidenceID: evidenceID, ReviewOverride: result.ReviewOverride, Diagnostics: result.Diagnostics, Issues: append([]SmokeIssue(nil), result.Issues...), Evidence: refs, Override: override, ActiveAttempt: active, LastComplete: &SmokeCompletion{Verdict: result.Verdict, Artifact: ArtifactRelPath(p.Sprint, StageSmoke), ArtifactDigest: artifactDigest, InputFingerprint: inputFingerprint, CompletedAt: now, RunID: result.RunID, AuthorRunID: result.AuthorRunID, AuthorModel: result.AuthorModel, AuthorChangedPaths: append([]string(nil), result.AuthorChangedPaths...), CoverageMapping: result.CoverageMapping, EvidenceID: evidenceID, Evidence: identityRefs, Issues: append([]SmokeIssue(nil), result.Issues...), Override: override}}
477: 	if err := SaveFlowState(s.root, p.Sprint, state); err != nil {
478: 		result.Reconciliation = true
479: 		return result, smokeError("smoke_reconciliation", "reconciliation", "smoke.md committed but flow state update failed", "Reconcile flow state by rerunning smoke.", err)
480: 	}
481: 	return result, nil
482: }

484: func RenderSmoke(r SmokeResult) string {

487: 	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "## Smoke Context\n\nProject: `%s`\nSprint: `%s`\nArtifact: `%s`\n\n", r.Project, r.Sprint, r.Artifact)
488: 	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "## Review Gate\n\nReview verdict: `%s`\nReview fingerprint: `%s`\nDiagnostic override: `%t`\nOverride rationale: %s\n\n", r.ReviewVerdict, r.ReviewFingerprint, r.ReviewOverride, printable(r.OverrideRationale))

498: 	b.WriteString("\n")
499: 	if mapping := r.CoverageMapping; mapping != nil {

501: 		for _, requirement := range mapping.Requirements {

508: 		b.WriteString("\n")

510: 	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "## Selected Scope And Rationale\n\nScope kind: `%s`\nScope: `%s`\nRationale: %s\nDuration class: `%s`\nCost class: `%s`\nDiagnostic only: `%t`\n\n", printable(r.ScopeKind), printable(r.Scope), printable(r.ScopeRationale), printable(r.DurationClass), printable(r.CostClass), r.DiagnosticOnly)
511: 	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "## Preconditions And Environment\n\nPrerequisites: %s\nEnvironment: bounded allowlist; values not persisted\nEvidence roots: `%s`\nEffective timeout: `%s` (source `%s`)\n\n", printable(strings.Join(r.Prerequisites, "; ")), printable(strings.Join(r.EvidenceRoots, ", ")), r.EffectiveTimeout, printable(r.TimeoutSource))
512: 	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "## Safe Invocation\n\nArgv: `%s`\n\n", printable(r.SafeArgv))
513: 	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "## Run Evidence\n\nRun ID: `%s`\nTotal: `%d`\nPassed: `%d`\nFailed: `%d`\nSkipped: `%d`\nErrors: `%d`\nDuration: `%s`\nRuntime: `%s`\nModel: `%s`\n\n", printable(r.RunID), r.Counts.Total, r.Counts.Passed, r.Counts.Failed, r.Counts.Skipped, r.Counts.Errors, r.Duration, printable(r.Runtime), printable(r.Model))
514: 	if len(r.Tests) > 0 {
515: 		b.WriteString("Executed tests:\n")
516: 		for _, test := range r.Tests {
517: 			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- `%s`: `%s`\n", test.ID, test.Status)
518: 		}
519: 		b.WriteString("\n")
520: 	}
521: 	b.WriteString("### External Evidence Identity And Links\n\n")
522: 	if len(r.Evidence) == 0 {
523: 		b.WriteString("- none (preflight classification)\n")
524: 	} else {
525: 		for _, e := range r.Evidence {
526: 			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- `%s` `%s` sha256 `%s` size `%d` modified `%s`\n", e.Kind, e.Path, e.SHA256, e.Size, e.ModifiedAt.Format(time.RFC3339))
527: 		}
528: 	}
529: 	b.WriteString("\n## Findings\n\n")
530: 	findings := 0
531: 	for _, issue := range r.Issues {
532: 		if issue.Status != "open" {
533: 			continue
534: 		}
535: 		findings++
536: 		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "### `%s` — %s\n\n", issue.TestID, printable(issue.Title))
537: 		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Severity: `%s`\n", printable(issue.Severity))
538: 		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Observed: %s\n", printable(issue.Summary))
539: 		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Working theory: %s\n", printable(issue.Theory))
540: 		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Supporting evidence: %s\n", printable(issue.Evidence))
541: 		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Next investigation: %s\n\n", printable(issue.Action))
542: 	}
543: 	if len(r.Diagnostics) == 0 && findings == 0 {
544: 		b.WriteString("- none\n")
545: 	} else {
546: 		for _, diagnostic := range r.Diagnostics {
547: 			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- %s\n", printable(diagnostic))
548: 		}
549: 	}
550: 	b.WriteString("\n## Open Issues\n\n")
551: 	open := false
552: 	for _, issue := range r.Issues {
553: 		if issue.Status == "open" {
554: 			open = true
555: 			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- `%s` (%s, test `%s`): `%s`\n", issue.ID, printable(issue.Severity), printable(issue.TestID), issue.Path)
556: 		}
557: 	}
558: 	if !open {
559: 		b.WriteString("- none\n")
560: 	}
561: 	b.WriteString("\n## Resolved Issues\n\n")
562: 	resolved := false
563: 	for _, issue := range r.Issues {
564: 		if issue.Status == "resolved" {
565: 			resolved = true
566: 			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- `%s` `%s`\n", issue.ID, issue.Path)
567: 		}
568: 	}
569: 	if !resolved {
570: 		b.WriteString("- none\n")
571: 	}
572: 	b.WriteString("\n## Mutation And Safety Check\n\nOnly smoke.md, flow-state.json, manifest-declared harness authoring paths, and manifest-declared external evidence roots were approved for mutation. Product source and governed sprint inputs were identity-checked before and after authoring.\n\n")
573: 	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "## Verdict And Next Action\n\nVerdict: `%s`\nNext action: %s\n", r.Verdict, printable(r.NextAction))
574: 	return b.String()
575: }

577: func ValidateSmokeContent(content string) []ValidationFinding {
578: 	var findings []ValidationFinding
579: 	if strings.TrimSpace(content) == "" || containsPlaceholder(content) {
580: 		findings = append(findings, finding("smoke.md", "", "", "empty or placeholder smoke summary", "summary is incomplete", "Generate a complete evidence-backed summary."))
581: 	}
582: 	for _, heading := range []string{"Smoke Context", "Review Gate", "Harness And Protocol", "Smoke Authoring", "Selected Scope And Rationale", "Preconditions And Environment", "Safe Invocation", "Run Evidence", "Findings", "Open Issues", "Resolved Issues", "Mutation And Safety Check", "Verdict And Next Action"} {
583: 		if !markdownHeadingPresent(content, heading) {
584: 			findings = append(findings, finding("smoke.md", heading, "", "missing required section", "section was not found", "Regenerate smoke.md."))
585: 		}
586: 	}
587: 	verdict := SmokeVerdict(fieldBacktick(content, "Verdict:"))
588: 	if !validSmokeVerdict(verdict) {
589: 		findings = append(findings, finding("smoke.md", "Verdict", "", "invalid verdict", string(verdict), "Use one of the five smoke verdicts."))
590: 	}
591: 	for _, forbidden := range []string{"-----BEGIN", "Authorization: Bearer", "\"stdout\":", "\"stderr\":"} {
592: 		if strings.Contains(content, forbidden) {
593: 			findings = append(findings, finding("smoke.md", "Safety", "", "raw or secret-bearing content detected", forbidden, "Keep raw streams and secrets in external evidence only."))

Important observation in smoke.go: `RunSmoke` marks the roadmap delivered at line 44-47 BEFORE publishing (line 54). And publication includes roadmap.md in workspace paths only when pass && !diagnosticOnly. The ordering: durable state (smoke.md, flow-state.json via commitSmoke inside runSmoke) → roadmap mark (file write) → publish. So publish is after durable state — good.

But wait, there's a subtle bug candidate: `publishSmokeStage` computes roadmap path as `filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(filepath.Dir(prepared.Sprint.Path)), "roadmap.md")` while `RunSmoke` computes it as `filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(filepath.Dir(sp.Path)), "roadmap.md")`. Same formula, presumably consistent. Need to check what Sprint.Path looks like: probably `<root>/project/sprints/<slug>`? Then Dir(Dir) = `<root>/project`... hmm, roadmap.md lives where? Let me check project.MarkRoadmapSprintDelivered and how roadmapPath is resolved elsewhere. If both use same formula they agree; but is the formula right? Let me check other places that locate roadmap.md — e.g., a store method like ReadRoadmap. If elsewhere they search or use different base, mismatch could cause `git add` failure on nonexistent path... but MarkRoadmapSprintDelivered would have already failed if path didn't exist. Actually MarkRoadmapSprintDelivered(roadmapPath...) requires the file to exist (it updates sprint status). Since RunSmoke already succeeded marking with the identical path formula before publishing, the file exists when publish runs. OK so consistent within this flow.

But hold on — `publishSmokeStage` adds roadmap.md to paths only when `result.Verdict == SmokePass && !result.DiagnosticOnly`, whereas RunSmoke marks roadmap when verdict==pass && !diagnosticOnly && review verdict pass/pass-with-findings. Slight condition difference (review verdict), but harmless: extra/missing roadmap in commit set just changes whether roadmap change is committed; if marked but not committed, roadmap change remains uncommitted working-tree change. Then next stage publish wouldn't include roadmap.md... it'd linger dirty. Hmm — actually wait: if review verdict is not pass (e.g., ForceReview override?), can result.Verdict be SmokePass with ReviewVerdict fail? Line 39: marks roadmap if status completed && verdict pass && !diagnosticOnly && review pass-ish. DiagnosticOnly is forced true when ForceReview and review failed (line 128). So verdict==pass implies review was fine mostly. Edge cases aside.

Now the more interesting issue: what happens when publish fails mid-way through `publishSmokeStage` — harness published, workspace not. Error joined and returned; retry of smoke re-runs whole harness. Idempotent-ish.

Let me now look at execute.go around 341, review.go 633, and importantly run_loop.go's deferred consumer goroutine (lines 220-300, 440-500). Also check `acquireMutationContext` for ctx handling, and config validation for PushTimeout.

443: 		}

445: 			mu.Lock()

481: func waitUntilRetry(ctx context.Context, retryAt time.Time, emit func()) {
482: 	for {
483: 		if emit != nil {
484: 			emit()
485: 		}
486: 		wait := time.Until(retryAt)
487: 		if wait <= 0 {
488: 			return
489: 		}
490: 		if wait > time.Minute {
491: 			wait = time.Minute
492: 		}
493: 		timer := time.NewTimer(wait)
494: 		select {
495: 		case <-ctx.Done():
496: 			timer.Stop()
497: 			return
498: 		case <-timer.C:
499: 		}
500: 	}
501: }

503: func emitRetryWait(state RunState, scope map[string]bool, statePath string, progress func(RunLoopProgress)) {
504: 	if progress == nil {
505: 		return
506: 	}
507: 	for _, task := range state.Tasks {
508: 		if !scope[task.ID] {
509: 			continue
510: 		}
511: 		if task.Status == TaskStatusRetrying && task.RetryAfter != nil && task.RetryAfter.After(time.Now().UTC()) {
512: 			progress(RunLoopProgress{Event: RunLoopProgressWaiting, Task: task, Counts: SummarizeRunStateCounts(state, statePath), ScopeCounts: summarizeRunStateCountsForScope(state, scope, statePath)})
513: 			return
514: 		}
515: 	}
516: }

518: func summarizeRunStateCountsForScope(state RunState, scope map[string]bool, statePath string) StatusSummary {
519: 	if len(scope) == 0 {
520: 		return StatusSummary{Complete: true, StatePath: statePath, RunID: state.RunID}
521: 	}
522: 	summary := StatusSummary{Complete: true, StatePath: statePath, RunID: state.RunID}
523: 	for _, task := range state.Tasks {
524: 		if !scope[task.ID] {
525: 			continue
526: 		}
527: 		summary.Total++
528: 		countTaskStatus(&summary, task)
529: 		if task.Status != TaskStatusCompleted && task.Status != TaskStatusSkipped {
530: 			summary.Complete = false
531: 		}
532: 	}
533: 	return summary
534: }

575: func progressEventForExecution(res ExecutionResult) RunLoopProgressEvent {
576: 	switch res.Status {
577: 	case ExecutionStatusCompleted, ExecutionStatusSkipped:
578: 		return RunLoopProgressCompleted
579: 	case ExecutionStatusCancelled:
580: 		return RunLoopProgressCancelled
581: 	default:
582: 		if executionShouldRetry(res) {
583: 			return RunLoopProgressWaiting
584: 		}
585: 		return RunLoopProgressFailed
586: 	}

600: func runnableTaskIDs(state RunState, scope map[string]bool, attempted map[string]bool, limit int, now time.Time, dimensionOrder []Dimension) []string {
601: 	if limit < 1 {
602: 		limit = 1
603: 	}
604: 	var ids []string
605: 	byID := map[string]TaskState{}
606: 	for _, task := range state.Tasks {
607: 		byID[task.ID] = task
608: 	}
609: 	ranks := dimensionPriorityRanks(dimensionOrder)
610: 	remainingRank := len(dimensionOrder)
611: 	// Dimension order remains a priority, but not a barrier: lower-priority
612: 	// dimensions backfill any workers the earlier tiers cannot occupy.
613: 	for rank := 0; rank <= remainingRank; rank++ {
614: 		for _, kind := range []TaskKind{TaskKindSynthesis, TaskKindAnalysis} {
615: 			for _, task := range state.Tasks {
616: 				if len(ids) >= limit {
617: 					return ids
618: 				}
619: 				if !scope[task.ID] || taskAttemptBlocked(task, attempted) || task.Kind != kind || !taskRunnable(task, now) {
620: 					continue
621: 				}
622: 				if dimensionTaskRank(task, ranks, remainingRank) != rank {
623: 					continue
624: 				}
625: 				if kind == TaskKindSynthesis && !dependenciesCompleteFrom(byID, task) && !dependenciesTerminalFrom(byID, task) {
626: 					continue
627: 				}
628: 				ids = append(ids, task.ID)
629: 			}
630: 		}
631: 	}
632: 	return ids
633: }

635: func dimensionPriorityRanks(order []Dimension) map[string]int {
636: 	ranks := make(map[string]int, len(order))
637: 	for i, dimension := range order {
638: 		ranks[dimension.Ref()] = i
639: 	}
640: 	return ranks
641: }

643: func dimensionTaskRank(task TaskState, ranks map[string]int, remainingRank int) int {
644: 	if rank, ok := ranks[task.DimensionRef]; ok {
645: 		return rank
646: 	}
647: 	return remainingRank
648: }

650: func runLoopScope(study Study, allSources []Source, scopeSources []Source, dimensions []Dimension, sourceFiltered bool) map[string]bool {
651: 	scope := map[string]bool{}
652: 	for _, dimension := range dimensions {
653: 		applicable := GetApplicableSources(scopeSources, dimension)
654: 		if len(applicable) == 0 {
655: 			continue
656: 		}
657: 		for _, source := range applicable {
658: 			scope[analysisTaskID(study, dimension, source)] = true
659: 		}
660: 		allApplicable := GetApplicableSources(allSources, dimension)
661: 		if !sourceFiltered || len(applicable) == len(allApplicable) {
662: 			scope[synthesisTaskID(study, dimension)] = true
663: 		}
664: 	}
665: 	return scope
666: }

668: func filterRunState(state RunState, scope map[string]bool) RunState {
669: 	if len(scope) == 0 {
670: 		out := state
671: 		out.Tasks = nil
672: 		out.Complete = true
673: 		return out
674: 	}
675: 	out := state
676: 	out.Tasks = make([]TaskState, 0, len(state.Tasks))
677: 	for _, task := range state.Tasks {
678: 		if scope[task.ID] {
679: 			out.Tasks = append(out.Tasks, task)
680: 		}
681: 	}
682: 	out.Complete = allTasksComplete(out)
683: 	return out
684: }

686: func taskAttemptBlocked(task TaskState, attempted map[string]bool) bool {
687: 	return attempted[task.ID] && task.Status != TaskStatusRetrying

690: func taskRunnable(task TaskState, now time.Time) bool {
691: 	switch task.Status {
692: 	case TaskStatusPending, TaskStatusFailed, TaskStatusCancelled, TaskStatusWaiting:

271: 		task, err := taskSnapshot(id)
272: 		if err != nil {
273: 			recordErr(err)
274: 			return
275: 		}
276: 		mu.Lock()
277: 		dependencyState := cloneRunState(state)
278: 		mu.Unlock()
279: 		if !dependenciesComplete(dependencyState, task) {
280: 			if dependenciesTerminal(dependencyState, task) {
281: 				recordErr(markSynthesisDependenciesFailed(update, id))
282: 				recordErr(recordHistory(id))
283: 				emitTask(RunLoopProgressFailed, id)
284: 				return
285: 			}
286: 			recordErr(update(id, func(t *TaskState) {
287: 				t.Status = TaskStatusWaiting
288: 				t.UpdatedAt = time.Now().UTC()
289: 			}))
290: 			emitTask(RunLoopProgressWaiting, id)
291: 			return
292: 		}
293: 		recordErr(update(id, func(t *TaskState) {
294: 			now := time.Now().UTC()
295: 			t.Status = TaskStatusRunning
296: 			t.Attempts++
297: 			t.StartedAt = &now
298: 			t.CompletedAt = nil
299: 			t.UpdatedAt = now
300: 			t.LastError = nil
301: 			t.RetryAfter = nil
302: 			t.Agent = AgentMetadata{}
303: 		}))
304: 		diagnostics.sample("runtime.start", id, 0, nil)
305: 		runtimeStarted := time.Now()
306: 		var res ExecutionResult
307: 		checkpointSession := func(session TaskSession) {
308: 			recordErr(update(id, func(t *TaskState) {
309: 				copy := session
310: 				t.Session = &copy
311: 				t.UpdatedAt = time.Now().UTC()
312: 			}))
313: 		}
314: 		switch task.Kind {
315: 		case TaskKindAnalysis:
316: 			res, err = s.RunAnalysis(ctx, ExecutionRequest{StudyRef: listing.Study.Name, DimensionRef: task.DimensionRef, SourceRef: task.Source, Model: req.Model, ResumeSession: task.Session, DeferPublication: true, OnSession: checkpointSession, OnEvent: func(event runtimeEvent) {
317: 				emitRuntime(id, event)
318: 			}})
319: 			if err != nil {
320: 				res = ExecutionResult{Status: ExecutionStatusRuntimeFailed, TaskKind: TaskKindAnalysis, Study: listing.Study, OutputPath: task.OutputPath, RuntimeError: safeError(err), RuntimeErr: err}
321: 			}
322: 		case TaskKindSynthesis:
323: 			res, err = s.Synthesize(ctx, SynthesisRequest{StudyRef: listing.Study.Name, DimensionRef: task.DimensionRef, SourceRefs: selectedSourceNames(listing.Sources), Model: req.Model, ResumeSession: task.Session, DeferPublication: true, OnSession: checkpointSession, OnEvent: func(event runtimeEvent) {
324: 				emitRuntime(id, event)
325: 			}})
326: 			if err != nil {
327: 				res = ExecutionResult{Status: ExecutionStatusRuntimeFailed, TaskKind: TaskKindSynthesis, Study: listing.Study, OutputPath: task.OutputPath, RuntimeError: safeError(err), RuntimeErr: err}
328: 			}
329: 		default:
330: 			recordErr(fmt.Errorf("unsupported task kind %q", task.Kind))
331: 			return
332: 		}
333: 		diagnostics.sample("runtime.end", id, time.Since(runtimeStarted), err)
334: 		recordErr(applyExecutionResult(update, id, res))
335: 		recordErr(recordHistory(id))
336: 		if res.Status == ExecutionStatusCompleted && publicationJobs != nil {
337: 			publicationJobs <- res
338: 		}
339: 		emitTask(progressEventForExecution(res), id)
340: 	}
341: 	done := make(chan struct{}, req.Parallelism)
342: 	active := 0
343: 	stopScheduling := false
344: 	for active > 0 || (!stopScheduling && ctx.Err() == nil) {
345: 		if loadFirstErr() != nil {
346: 			stopScheduling = true
347: 		}
348: 		pressure := readMemoryPressure()
349: 		mu.Lock()
350: 		previousParallelism := effectiveParallelism
351: 		if pressure.Stretched && effectiveParallelism > 1 {
352: 			effectiveParallelism--
353: 		} else if pressure.Recovered && effectiveParallelism < req.Parallelism {
354: 			effectiveParallelism++
355: 		}
356: 		memoryAvailable = pressure.AvailableBytes
357: 		if effectiveParallelism != previousParallelism {
358: 			if effectiveParallelism < previousParallelism {
359: 				schedulingMessage = fmt.Sprintf("memory pressure reduced parallelism from %d to %d", previousParallelism, effectiveParallelism)
360: 				diagnostics.scheduling("parallelism.throttled", req.Parallelism, effectiveParallelism, pressure.AvailableBytes)
361: 			} else {
362: 				schedulingMessage = fmt.Sprintf("memory recovered; restored parallelism from %d to %d", previousParallelism, effectiveParallelism)
363: 				diagnostics.scheduling("parallelism.restored", req.Parallelism, effectiveParallelism, pressure.AvailableBytes)
364: 			}
365: 		}
366: 		parallelismChanged := effectiveParallelism != previousParallelism
367: 		changeEvent := RunLoopProgressRestored
368: 		if effectiveParallelism < previousParallelism {
369: 			changeEvent = RunLoopProgressThrottled
370: 		}
371: 		mu.Unlock()
372: 		if parallelismChanged {
373: 			emit(changeEvent, TaskState{})
374: 		}
375: 		disk := readSchedulerDiskPressure(listing.Study.Path)
376: 		if disk.Pressured {
377: 			// When no worker can make progress, retained stores must not pin the
378: 			// scheduler below its admission threshold forever. Active workers keep
379: 			// their resumable stores unless pressure becomes critical.
380: 			aggressiveCleanup := disk.Critical || active == 0
381: 			cleanup := runtimepkg.CleanupRuntimeStores(listing.Study.Path, 72*time.Hour, 2*1024*1024*1024, aggressiveCleanup)
382: 			diagnostics.storage("disk.admission_paused", cleanup, disk)
383: 			disk = readSchedulerDiskPressure(listing.Study.Path)
384: 			if disk.Pressured {
385: 				mu.Lock()
386: 				schedulingMessage = fmt.Sprintf("disk pressure paused new workers; %.1f%% used, %d MiB available", disk.UsedPercent, disk.AvailableBytes/(1024*1024))
387: 				mu.Unlock()
388: 				if active > 0 {
389: 					<-done
390: 					active--
391: 					continue
392: 				}
393: 				timer := time.NewTimer(30 * time.Second)
394: 				select {
395: 				case <-ctx.Done():
396: 					timer.Stop()
397: 				case <-timer.C:
398: 				}
399: 				continue
400: 			}
401: 		}
402: 		diskCap := diskParallelismCap(disk, req.Parallelism)
403: 		if diskCap > 0 && diskCap < effectiveParallelism {
404: 			mu.Lock()
405: 			previous := effectiveParallelism
406: 			effectiveParallelism = diskCap
407: 			schedulingMessage = fmt.Sprintf("disk headroom reduced parallelism from %d to %d", previous, effectiveParallelism)
408: 			mu.Unlock()
409: 			diagnostics.scheduling("parallelism.disk_throttled", req.Parallelism, effectiveParallelism, disk.AvailableBytes)
410: 			emit(RunLoopProgressThrottled, TaskState{})
411: 		}
412: 		available := effectiveParallelism - active
413: 		var ids []string
414: 		var nextRetry *time.Time
415: 		mu.Lock()
416: 		now := time.Now().UTC()
417: 		if !stopScheduling && available > 0 {
418: 			ids = runnableTaskIDs(state, scope, attempted, available, now, listing.DimensionOrder)
419: 			nextRetry = nextRetryAfter(state, scope, now)
420: 		}
421: 		mu.Unlock()
422: 		for _, id := range ids {
423: 			attempted[id] = true
424: 			active++
425: 			// Emit Started at claim time so progress ordering matches the
426: 			// scheduler's deterministic tier order rather than racing worker
427: 			// goroutines.
428: 			emitTask(RunLoopProgressStarted, id)
429: 			go func(id string) {
430: 				runTask(id)
431: 				done <- struct{}{}
432: 			}(id)
433: 		}
434: 		if active > 0 {
435: 			// Each task owns its OpenCode database, so a completed slot can be
436: 			// refilled without waiting for sibling cleanup.
437: 			<-done
438: 			active--
439: 			continue
440: 		}
441: 		if stopScheduling || (len(ids) == 0 && nextRetry == nil) {
442: 			break
443: 		}
444: 		waitUntilRetry(ctx, *nextRetry, func() {
445: 			mu.Lock()
446: 			defer mu.Unlock()
447: 			emitRetryWait(state, scope, result.StatePath, req.Progress)
448: 		})
449: 	}
450: 	if publicationJobs != nil {
451: 		close(publicationJobs)
452: 		<-publicationDone
453: 	}
454: 	if err := loadFirstErr(); err != nil {
455: 		return result, err
456: 	}
457: 
458: 	state.Complete = allTasksComplete(state)
459: 	if err := save(); err != nil {
460: 		return result, err
461: 	}
462: 	if err := SyncRunHistory(listing.Study, state); err != nil {
463: 		return result, err
464: 	}
465: 	if s.publisher != nil {
466: 		publication, publishErr := s.publishRunLoopState(ctx, listing.Study)
467: 		if len(publication) > 0 {
468: 			result.Publications = append(result.Publications, publication...)
469: 		}
470: 		if publishErr != nil {
471: 			return result, publishErr
472: 		}
473: 	}
474: 	result.State = state
475: 	result.Counts = runLoopCounts(state)
476: 	result.ScopeCounts = runLoopCounts(filterRunState(state, scope))
477: 	result.Status = runLoopStatus(filterRunState(state, scope), result.ScopeCounts, ctx.Err() != nil)
478: 	return result, nil
479: }

481: func waitUntilRetry(ctx context.Context, retryAt time.Time, emit func()) {
482: 	for {
483: 		if emit != nil {
484: 			emit()
485: 		}
486: 		wait := time.Until(retryAt)
487: 		if wait <= 0 {
488: 			return
489: 		}
490: 		if wait > time.Minute {
491: 			wait = time.Minute
492: 		}
493: 		timer := time.NewTimer(wait)
494: 		select {
495: 		case <-ctx.Done():
496: 			timer.Stop()
497: 			return
498: 		case <-timer.C:
499: 		}
500: 	}
501: }

503: func emitRetryWait(state RunState, scope map[string]bool, statePath string, progress func(RunLoopProgress)) {
504: 	if progress == nil {
505: 		return
506: 	}
507: 	for _, task := range state.Tasks {
508: 		if !scope[task.ID] {
509: 			continue
510: 		}
511: 		if task.Status == TaskStatusRetrying && task.RetryAfter != nil && task.RetryAfter.After(time.Now().UTC()) {
512: 			progress(RunLoopProgress{Event: RunLoopProgressWaiting, Task: task, Counts: SummarizeRunStateCounts(state, statePath), ScopeCounts: summarizeRunStateCountsForScope(state, scope, statePath)})
513: 			return
514: 		}
515: 	}
516: }

518: func summarizeRunStateCountsForScope(state RunState, scope map[string]bool, statePath string) StatusSummary {
519: 	if len(scope) == 0 {
520: 		return StatusSummary{Complete: true, StatePath: statePath, RunID: state.RunID}
521: 	}
522: 	summary := StatusSummary{Complete: true, StatePath: statePath, RunID: state.RunID}
523: 	for _, task := range state.Tasks {
524: 		if !scope[task.ID] {
525: 			continue
526: 		}
527: 		summary.Total++
528: 		countTaskStatus(&summary, task)
529: 		if task.Status != TaskStatusCompleted && task.Status != TaskStatusSkipped {
530: 			summary.Complete = false
531: 		}
532: 	}
533: 	return summary
534: }

600: func runnableTaskIDs(state RunState, scope map[string]bool, attempted map[string]bool, limit int, now time.Time, dimensionOrder []Dimension) []string {
601: 	if limit < 1 {
602: 		limit = 1
603: 	}
604: 	var ids []string
605: 	byID := map[string]TaskState{}
606: 	for _, task := range state.Tasks {
607: 		byID[task.ID] = task
608: 	}
609: 	ranks := dimensionPriorityRanks(dimensionOrder)
610: 	remainingRank := len(dimensionOrder)
611: 	// Dimension order remains a priority, but not a barrier: lower-priority
612: 	// dimensions backfill any workers the earlier tiers cannot occupy.
613: 	for rank := 0; rank <= remainingRank; rank++ {
614: 		for _, kind := range []TaskKind{TaskKindSynthesis, TaskKindAnalysis} {
615: 			for _, task := range state.Tasks {
616: 				if len(ids) >= limit {
617: 					return ids
618: 				}
619: 				if !scope[task.ID] || taskAttemptBlocked(task, attempted) || task.Kind != kind || !taskRunnable(task, now) {
620: 					continue
621: 				}
622: 				if dimensionTaskRank(task, ranks, remainingRank) != rank {
623: 					continue
624: 				}
625: 				if kind == TaskKindSynthesis && !dependenciesCompleteFrom(byID, task) && !dependenciesTerminalFrom(byID, task) {
626: 					continue
627: 				}
628: 				ids = append(ids, task.ID)
629: 			}
630: 		}
631: 	}
632: 	return ids
633: }

635: func dimensionPriorityRanks(order []Dimension) map[string]int {
636: 	ranks := make(map[string]int, len(order))
637: 	for i, dimension := range order {
638: 		ranks[dimension.Ref()] = i
639: 	}
640: 	return ranks
641: }

643: func dimensionTaskRank(task TaskState, ranks map[string]int, remainingRank int) int {
644: 	if rank, ok := ranks[task.DimensionRef]; ok {
645: 		return rank
646: 	}
647: 	return remainingRank
648: }

650: func runLoopScope(study Study, allSources []Source, scopeSources []Source, dimensions []Dimension, sourceFiltered bool) map[string]bool {
651: 	scope := map[string]bool{}
652: 	for _, dimension := range dimensions {
653: 		applicable := GetApplicableSources(scopeSources, dimension)
654: 		if len(applicable) == 0 {
655: 			continue
656: 		}
657: 		for _, source := range applicable {
658: 			scope[analysisTaskID(study, dimension, source)] = true
659: 		}
660: 		allApplicable := GetApplicableSources(allSources, dimension)
661: 		if !sourceFiltered || len(applicable) == len(allApplicable) {
662: 			scope[synthesisTaskID(study, dimension)] = true
663: 		}
664: 	}
665: 	return scope

668: func filterRunState(state RunState, scope map[string]bool) RunState {
669: 	if len(scope) == 0 {
670: 		out := state
671: 		out.Tasks = nil
672: 		out.Complete = true
673: 		return out
674: 	}
675: 	out := state
676: 	out.Tasks = make([]TaskState, 0, len(state.Tasks))
677: 	for _, task := range state.Tasks {
678: 		if scope[task.ID] {
679: 			out.Tasks = append(out.Tasks, task)
680: 		}
681: 	}
682: 	out.Complete = allTasksComplete(out)
683: 	return out
684: }

686: func taskAttemptBlocked(task TaskState, attempted map[string]bool) bool {
687: 	return attempted[task.ID] && task.Status != TaskStatusRetrying
688: }

690: func taskRunnable(task TaskState, now time.Time) bool {
691: 	switch task.Status {
692: 	case TaskStatusPending, TaskStatusFailed, TaskStatusCancelled, TaskStatusWaiting:
693: 		if task.RetryAfter != nil && task.RetryAfter.After(now) {
694: 			return false
695: 		}
696: 		return true
697: 	case TaskStatusRetrying:
698: 		return task.RetryAfter == nil || !task.RetryAfter.After(now)
699: 	default:
700: 		return false
701: 	}
702: }
703: 
704: func nextRetryAfter(state RunState, scope map[string]bool, now time.Time) *time.Time {
705: 	var next *time.Time
706: 	for _, task := range state.Tasks {
707: 		if !scope[task.ID] {
708: 			continue
709: 		}
710: 		if task.Status != TaskStatusRetrying || task.RetryAfter == nil || !task.RetryAfter.After(now) {
711: 			continue
712: 		}
713: 		retry := *task.RetryAfter
714: 		if next == nil || retry.Before(*next) {
715: 			next = &retry
716: 		}
717: 	}
718: 	return next
719: }

721: func dependenciesComplete(state RunState, task TaskState) bool {
722: 	byID := map[string]TaskState{}
723: 	for _, item := range state.Tasks {
724: 		byID[item.ID] = item
725: 	}
726: 	return dependenciesCompleteFrom(byID, task)

729: func dependenciesCompleteFrom(byID map[string]TaskState, task TaskState) bool {
730: 	for _, dep := range task.Dependencies {
731: 		if byID[dep.TaskID].Status != TaskStatusCompleted {
732: 			return false
733: 		}
734: 	}

738: func readySynthesisTaskIDs(state RunState, attempted map[string]bool, now time.Time) []string {
739: 	byID := map[string]TaskState{}
740: 	for _, task := range state.Tasks {
741: 		byID[task.ID] = task
742: 	}
743: 	var ids []string
744: 	for _, task := range state.Tasks {
745: 		if attempted[task.ID] || task.Kind != TaskKindSynthesis || !taskRunnable(task, now) {
746: 			continue
747: 		}
748: 		if dependenciesCompleteFrom(byID, task) {
749: 			ids = append(ids, task.ID)
750: 		}
751: 	}

755: func dependenciesTerminal(state RunState, task TaskState) bool {
756: 	byID := map[string]TaskState{}

758: 		byID[item.ID] = item
759: 	}

763: func dependenciesTerminalFrom(byID map[string]TaskState, task TaskState) bool {
764: 	for _, dep := range task.Dependencies {
765: 		depTask, ok := byID[dep.TaskID]
766: 		if !ok {
767: 			return true
768: 		}
769: 		switch depTask.Status {
770: 		case TaskStatusCompleted, TaskStatusFailed, TaskStatusCancelled, TaskStatusSkipped:
771: 			continue
772: 		default:
773: 			return false
774: 		}
775: 	}
776: 	return true
777: }

779: func applyExecutionResult(update func(string, func(*TaskState)) error, id string, res ExecutionResult) error {
780: 	return update(id, func(t *TaskState) {
781: 		now := time.Now().UTC()
782: 		t.UpdatedAt = now
783: 		t.CompletedAt = &now
784: 		t.Agent = res.Agent
785: 		if t.Agent.RunID == "" {
786: 			t.Agent.RunID = res.RuntimeRunID
787: 		}
788: 		if t.Agent.Status == "" {
789: 			t.Agent.Status = res.RuntimeStatus
790: 		}
791: 		if retryAfter := retryAfterFromAgent(t.Agent); retryAfter != nil {
792: 			t.RetryAfter = retryAfter
793: 		}
794: 		if res.Validation.Path != "" {
795: 			summary := validationSummary(res.Validation, now)
796: 			t.Validation = &summary
797: 		}
798: 		if t.Agent.Cleanup.Attempted && !t.Agent.Cleanup.Completed {
799: 			t.Session = nil
800: 		}
801: 		switch res.Status {
802: 		case ExecutionStatusCompleted, ExecutionStatusSkipped:
803: 			t.Status = TaskStatusCompleted
804: 			t.RetryAfter = nil
805: 			t.Session = nil
806: 		case ExecutionStatusCancelled:
807: 			t.Status = TaskStatusCancelled
808: 			t.LastError = executionTaskError("runtime.cancelled", res)
809: 		case ExecutionStatusValidationFailed, ExecutionStatusPreflightBlocked:
810: 			t.Status = TaskStatusFailed
811: 			t.LastError = executionTaskError("validation.failed", res)
812: 			t.LastError.Path = res.OutputPath
813: 		default:
814: 			if executionShouldRetry(res) {
815: 				t.Status = TaskStatusRetrying
816: 				if t.RetryAfter == nil {
817: 					retry := now.Add(defaultRuntimeRetryDelay(res))
818: 					t.RetryAfter = &retry
819: 				}
820: 			} else {
821: 				t.Status = TaskStatusFailed
822: 			}
823: 			t.LastError = executionTaskError("runtime.failed", res)
824: 		}
825: 	})
826: }

828: func executionTaskError(code string, res ExecutionResult) *TaskError {
829: 	detail := compactDiagnostic(res.RuntimeDetail)
830: 	if detail == "" {
831: 		for _, attempt := range res.Agent.Attempts {
832: 			if attempt.ErrorDetail != "" {
833: 				detail = compactDiagnostic(attempt.ErrorDetail)
834: 				break
835: 			}
836: 		}
837: 	}
838: 	return &TaskError{Code: code, Message: safeExecutionMessage(res), Detail: detail}
839: }

841: func executionShouldRetry(res ExecutionResult) bool {
842: 	switch res.RuntimeCategory {
843: 	case "rate_limit", "timeout", "provider_unavailable", "runtime_unavailable":
844: 		return true
845: 	default:
846: 		return false
847: 	}
848: }

850: func defaultRuntimeRetryDelay(res ExecutionResult) time.Duration {
851: 	if res.RuntimeCategory == "rate_limit" {
852: 		return 10 * time.Minute
853: 	}
854: 	return 2 * time.Minute
855: }

206: func studyMutableInputDigest(workspaceRoot string, prompt PromptResult, kind TaskKind, source Source, inputs fileSnapshot, inputsErr error) (string, error) {

209: 	}

211: 	switch kind {

214: 			break
215: 		}
216: 		for path, digest := range inputs {
217: 			rel, err := filepath.Rel(source.Path, path)
218: 			if err != nil || rel == ".." || strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)) {
219: 				if err == nil {
220: 					continue
221: 				}
222: 				return "input-unavailable", err
223: 			}
224: 			entries[filepath.ToSlash(rel)] = digest
225: 		}
226: 	case TaskKindSynthesis:
227: 		for _, rel := range prompt.Manifest.InputReportPaths {
228: 			path, err := workspace.ResolveInside(workspaceRoot, rel)
229: 			if err != nil {

296: 	for _, record := range records {

298: 	}

303: 	return status == TaskStatusCompleted || status == TaskStatusFailed || status == TaskStatusCancelled || status == TaskStatusSkipped
304: }

307: 	completed := ""

310: 	}

Run-state files also carry schema versions. Commands such as `study status`, `study validate`, and `study run-loop` reject unsupported run-state schema versions instead of silently migrating them.

## Runtime And Model Mapping

UltraPlan delegates runtime execution through agentwrap and the OpenCode adapter:

- `agentwrap.executable` maps to `opencode.WithExecutable`.
- `agentwrap.extra_args` maps to OpenCode extra args.
- `agentwrap.env` maps to OpenCode environment additions.
- `models.primary` maps to the primary agentwrap provider/model request.
- `models.default` is used when primary cannot be split into provider/model.
- `models.backup` configures an agentwrap fallback target when it differs from primary.
- `execution.default_timeout` maps to the runtime request timeout.
- `execution.default_retries` configures retry policy attempts.
- `agentwrap.required_health` maps to required runtime health checks.
- `agentwrap.required_capabilities` maps to required runtime capabilities.
- `agentwrap.sandbox`, `agentwrap.permission_mode`, `agentwrap.permission_default`, and `agentwrap.permission_unsupported_behavior` map to agentwrap sandbox and permission policy fields.

UltraPlan does not own OpenCode provider credentials or provider billing. Configure those through OpenCode/provider-native mechanisms.

## Git stage publication

`git.stage_completion` controls publication after a study task or sprint stage has produced valid canonical output and persisted its state. `commit` creates a local commit. `commit-and-push` also pushes the current branch, using its upstream when present or `git.remote` when no upstream exists. `off` preserves the working tree without Git mutation.

UltraPlan commits only paths owned by the completed stage. It leaves unrelated staged and unstaged changes alone. Execute is different because its recorded Git worktree belongs to one sprint; UltraPlan commits the complete worktree change set there. Agents remain prohibited from running `git add`, `git commit`, or `git push` themselves.

A push failure does not reopen a completed product stage. The command returns an error and leaves the local commit in place. Rerunning the stage pushes that commit without creating a duplicate. Git commands never prompt for credentials, and `git.push_timeout` bounds each push attempt.

## Smoke Configuration

Smoke configuration is resolved after manifest defaults and before command/TUI overrides. UltraPlan passes only named environment variables; values never appear in config output, JSON, Markdown, or TUI diagnostics. The built-in platform set is limited to `TMPDIR`, `LANG`, and `LC_ALL`; `PATH` and `HOME` are not forwarded by default. Add a manifest-declared name to `smoke.environment` only when the harness genuinely needs it. The real-harness test lane is opt-in with `ULTRAPLAN_REAL_SMOKE=1`; normal tests never launch it.

## Redaction

UltraPlan redacts sensitive-looking values in config, logs, diagnostics, status output, and health output. Do not place provider tokens in `ultraplan.yml`; prefer runtime-native environment or credential stores. Release evidence must not include provider tokens, full sensitive environment dumps, full prompts, full report bodies, or raw unsafe runtime payloads.
## Run-control retention and quota

effective-configuration reporting and are safe to expose through redacted

222: 	}

226: func writeRunTable(b *strings.Builder, rows []RunHistoryRecord, empty string) {
227: 	if len(rows) == 0 {

229: 		return
230: 	}

232: 	for _, row := range rows {
233: 		fmt.Fprintf(b, "| %s | %s | %s | %s | %s | %s | %s | %s | %s |\n", formatTime(row.CompletedAt), md(row.DimensionRef), md(displayRecordSource(row)), row.Kind, row.Status, formatDuration(time.Duration(row.DurationMS)*time.Millisecond), md(emptyDash(row.Model)), formatIntKnown(row.TotalTokens, row.TotalTokensKnown), formatCost(row.CostAmount, row.CostCurrency, row.CostKnown))
234: 	}

236: }

238: type recordSummary struct {
239: 	runs             int
240: 	completed        int
241: 	failed           int
242: 	totalDuration    time.Duration
243: 	avgDuration      time.Duration
244: 	totalTokens      int64
245: 	totalTokensKnown bool
246: 	costAmount       float64
247: 	costCurrency     string
248: 	costKnown        bool
249: }
250: 
251: func summarizeRecords(records []RunHistoryRecord) recordSummary {
252: 	var out recordSummary
253: 	for _, record := range records {
254: 		out.runs++
255: 		if record.Status == TaskStatusCompleted {
256: 			out.completed++
257: 		}
258: 		if record.Status == TaskStatusFailed {
259: 			out.failed++
260: 		}
261: 		out.totalDuration += time.Duration(record.DurationMS) * time.Millisecond
262: 		if record.TotalTokensKnown {
263: 			out.totalTokensKnown = true
264: 			out.totalTokens += record.TotalTokens
265: 		}
266: 		if record.CostKnown {
267: 			out.costKnown = true
268: 			out.costAmount += record.CostAmount
269: 			if out.costCurrency == "" {
270: 				out.costCurrency = record.CostCurrency
271: 			}
272: 			if out.costCurrency != record.CostCurrency {
273: 				out.costCurrency = "mixed"
274: 			}
275: 		}
276: 	}
277: 	if out.runs > 0 {
278: 		out.avgDuration = out.totalDuration / time.Duration(out.runs)
279: 	}
280: 	return out
281: }
282: 
283: func sortedKeys[T any](m map[string]T) []string {
284: 	keys := make([]string, 0, len(m))
285: 	for key := range m {
286: 		keys = append(keys, key)
287: 	}
288: 	sort.Strings(keys)
289: 	return keys
290: }
291: 
292: func sortedRecordKeys(m map[string][]RunHistoryRecord) []string {
293: 	return sortedKeys(m)
294: }

296: func displaySource(task TaskState) string {
297: 	if task.Source == "" {
298: 		return "(synthesis)"
299: 	}
300: 	return task.Source
301: }
302: 
303: func displayRecordSource(record RunHistoryRecord) string {
304: 	if record.Source == "" {
305: 		return "(synthesis)"
306: 	}
307: 	return record.Source
308: }
309: 
310: func formatDuration(d time.Duration) string {
311: 	if d <= 0 {
312: 		return "-"
313: 	}
314: 	d = d.Round(time.Second)
315: 	if d < time.Minute {
316: 		return d.String()
317: 	}
318: 	return fmt.Sprintf("%dm%02ds", int(d.Minutes()), int(d.Seconds())%60)
319: }
320: 
321: func formatIntKnown(v int64, known bool) string {
322: 	if !known {
323: 		return "-"
324: 	}
325: 	return fmt.Sprintf("%d", v)
326: }
327: 
328: func formatCost(amount float64, currency string, known bool) string {
329: 	if !known {
330: 		return "-"
331: 	}
332: 	if currency == "" {
333: 		currency = "cost"
334: 	}
335: 	return fmt.Sprintf("%.4f %s", amount, currency)
336: }
337: 
338: func formatTime(t *time.Time) string {
339: 	if t == nil {
340: 		return "-"
341: 	}
342: 	return t.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)
343: }

118: func dimensionExecutionGroups(selected, priority []Dimension) [][]Dimension {
119: 	selectedByRef := make(map[string]Dimension, len(selected))

122: 	}

124: 	prioritized := make(map[string]bool, len(priority))
125: 	for _, dimension := range priority {
126: 		selectedDimension, ok := selectedByRef[dimension.Ref()]
127: 		if !ok {
128: 			continue
129: 		}
130: 		groups = append(groups, []Dimension{selectedDimension})
131: 		prioritized[dimension.Ref()] = true
132: 	}
133: 	var remaining []Dimension
134: 	for _, dimension := range selected {
135: 		if !prioritized[dimension.Ref()] {
136: 			remaining = append(remaining, dimension)
137: 		}
138: 	}
139: 	if len(remaining) > 0 {
140: 		groups = append(groups, remaining)
141: 	}

165: 	}

193: 	var tasks []analysisTask

211: }

214: 	var blockers []string

232: 		case ExecutionStatusSkipped, ExecutionStatusPreflightBlocked:
233: 			counts.Skipped++
234: 		case ExecutionStatusCancelled:
235: 			counts.Pending++
236: 		default:
237: 			counts.Failed++
238: 		}
239: 	}

243: func statusRunAll(result RunAllResult, cancelled bool) RunAllStatus {
244: 	if cancelled {
245: 		return RunAllStatusCancelled
246: 	}
247: 	if result.Counts.Failed == 0 && result.Counts.Pending == 0 && result.Counts.Skipped == 0 {
248: 		return RunAllStatusCompleted
249: 	}
250: 	if result.Counts.Completed > 0 && (result.Counts.Failed > 0 || result.Counts.Skipped > 0 || result.Counts.Pending > 0) {

256: 		}
257: 	}

reasoning_details.text:
**Defect confirmed empirically.**

- Attempt 1: commit lands (`owned.txt` in HEAD), but the index-reconcile `git reset` fails (index.lock contention from a concurrent user git operation). Publish returns an error — correct so far.
- Post-failure state: user's real index now shows BOTH `staged.txt` AND `owned.txt` as staged changes relative to HEAD. The `owned.txt` entry is a phantom staged *revert* of UltraPlan's own published commit — the user never staged it.
- Attempt 2 (the documented recovery: "Rerunning the stage pushes that commit without creating a duplicate"): succeeds, reports Committed:false — but takes the `tree == parentTree` early-return path at publisher.go:241-242 which skips the reconcile reset. The phantom staged entry for `owned.txt` persists indefinitely.

Observable bad outcome: after any retry, the user's index permanently contains a staged change reverting UltraPlan's publication. If the user later commits their staged work (a normal action — they staged something themselves), the revert of the published stage content is committed and can be pushed upstream. Also `git status` is misleading from then on.

Trigger/preconditions:
1. Mode != off; stage publish runs.
2. Concurrent git operation holding `.git/index.lock` during the window between `update-ref` (publisher.go:253) and `reset -q` (publisher.go:256-257) — or any other reset failure (disk full, index corruption).
3. Then one rerun of the same stage (the documented recovery).

Existing controls / counter-evidence searched:
- flock serializes ultraplan-vs-ultraplan only; user git processes don't take `ultraplan-publish.lock`.
- CAS update-ref protects the ref, not the real index.
- Retry path deliberately skips reconcile when tree matches parent tree (publisher.go:241) — that's the exact gap.
- Tests: TestPublisherCommitsOnlyOwnedPathsAndPreservesIndex pins happy-path preservation only; no test exercises reset failure.

Severity: medium-low (reliability/data-integrity of user's index; requires a concurrent git op at a narrow window, but consequences persist silently and can propagate to upstream via user commit). Confidence high (reproduced end-to-end with verbatim code).

Regression test sketch: reproduce probe above as Go test — hold index.lock through first Publish (assert error mentions reconcile), release, re-Publish, assert `git diff --cached --name-only` == ["staged.txt"]. Fix direction: on the no-change retry path (and/or before returning), still run the reconcile `reset -q HEAD -- paths` when committed==false but a previous attempt may have advanced the branch... simplest robust fix: always run the reconcile reset when `paths` were staged into temp index (i.e., move reset out of the "committed" branch, or run it whenever result.Commit advanced vs original parent observed at entry). Alternatively compare real-index entries for owned paths against HEAD and repair if they differ.

Wait, actually let me think about whether running reset unconditionally on the no-op path is safe: on the pure no-change path (nothing ever failed), resetting owned paths to HEAD is harmless (they already match or record intentional user staging?). Hmm — careful: what if the USER deliberately has an owned path staged-but-uncommitted (e.g., user edits requirements.md and stages it while sprint flow considers the stage complete)? Happy path today: publishPlanningStage on completed stage → no-op → user's staged edit untouched. With unconditional reset, their deliberate staged edit gets wiped from the index. That would violate the core promise ("leaves unrelated staged and unstaged changes alone" — well, owned-path staging is related, but still user intent).

So the safe fix is narrower: detect divergence between real index and HEAD for owned paths caused by OUR commit (i.e., worktree blob == HEAD blob but index blob != HEAD blob) and reconcile only then. Or: perform the reconcile immediately after update-ref within the same critical section and treat its failure as fatal-but-flagged, storing enough state to repair on next run. Anyway, the finding stands regardless of fix choice.

1. **Orphaned grandchildren on push timeout** (exec.CommandContext kills only git, not ssh children). Check whether anything else mitigates (e.g., GIT_SSH_COMMAND batch mode set anywhere? grep BatchMode / GIT_SSH in repo).

So a single task-publication failure (say transient push rejection) skips the final durable-state save + history sync + run-state publication, even though all tasks finished and state was persisted incrementally by `persist()` (which saves continuously anyway — last incremental persist may be up to 250ms stale... plus force save skipped).
